  <TARGETS>...

  -m, --mode <MODE>
          Scan mode: intelligent (context-aware, default), fast, normal, thorough, insane

          Possible values:

          - fast:        Legacy: 50 payloads globally
          - normal:      Legacy: 500 payloads globally
          - thorough:    Legacy: 5000 payloads globally
          - insane:      Legacy: unlimited payloads globally
          
          [default: intelligent]

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Output file path

          Output format: json, html, pdf, sarif, markdown, csv, xlsx
          
          [default: json]
          [possible values: json, html, pdf, sarif, markdown, csv, xlsx, junit]

      --subdomains
          Enable subdomain enumeration

      --dorks
          Generate Google dork queries for reconnaissance (not enabled by default)

      --crawl <CRAWL>
          Enable web crawler (enabled by default to discover real parameters)
          
          [default: true]
          [possible values: true, false]

      --max-depth <MAX_DEPTH>
          Maximum crawl depth
          
          [default: 3]

      --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>
          Maximum concurrent requests
          
          [default: 50]

      --timeout <TIMEOUT>
          Request timeout in seconds
          
          [default: 30]

  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose output

  -d, --debug
          Enable debug output

      --user-agent <USER_AGENT>
          Custom User-Agent string

      --cookie <COOKIE>
          Authentication cookie

  -q, --quiet
          Quiet mode - only show vulnerabilities

  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          Configuration file path

      --token <TOKEN>
          Authentication bearer token

      --basic-auth <BASIC_AUTH>
          HTTP Basic auth (user:pass)

  -L, --license-key <LICENSE_KEY>
          License key (or set LONKERO_LICENSE_KEY environment variable)
          
          [env: LONKERO_LICENSE_KEY=]

      --auth-username <AUTH_USERNAME>
          Auto-login username (requires --auth-password)

      --auth-password <AUTH_PASSWORD>
          Auto-login password (requires --auth-username)

      --auth-login-url <AUTH_LOGIN_URL>
          Custom login URL (for auto-login)

  -H, --header <HEADER>
          Custom headers (format: "Header: Value")

      --skip <SKIP>
          Skip specific scanner modules

      --only <ONLY>
          Only run specific scanner modules

      --proxy <PROXY>
          Proxy URL (http://host:port)

      --insecure
          Disable TLS certificate verification

      --rate-limit <RATE_LIMIT>
          Rate limit (requests per second)
          
          [default: 100]

      --no-rate-limit
          Disable rate limiting entirely (use with caution!)

      --admin-username <ADMIN_USERNAME>
          Admin username for multi-role authorization testing

      --admin-password <ADMIN_PASSWORD>
          Admin password for multi-role authorization testing

      --admin-login-url <ADMIN_LOGIN_URL>
          Admin login URL (if different from user login URL)

      --multi-role
          Enable multi-role authorization testing (requires both user and admin credentials)

      --record-session
          Enable session recording during headless crawling

      --session-output <SESSION_OUTPUT>
          Session recording output file (default: session_recording.har)

      --session-format <SESSION_FORMAT>
          Session recording format: har, json, html

          Possible values:
          - har:  HAR format (HTTP Archive) - compatible with browser dev tools
          - json: JSON timeline format with all events
          - html: Interactive HTML report with timeline
          
          [default: har]

      --payload-intensity <PAYLOAD_INTENSITY>
          Payload intensity override: auto (default), minimal (50), standard (500), extended (5000), maximum (all) In intelligent mode, this overrides per-parameter intensity. In legacy modes, ignored

          Possible values:
          - auto:     Auto: Use intelligent mode's per-parameter risk scoring (default)
          - minimal:  Minimal: 50 payloads per parameter (fastest, may miss some vulns)
          - standard: Standard: 500 payloads per parameter (balanced)
          - extended: Extended: 5000 payloads per parameter (thorough)
          - maximum:  Maximum: All available payloads (slowest, best coverage)
          
          [default: auto]

      --browser-assist
          Enable Browser-Assist mode: route requests through real browser for authentic TLS fingerprints Requires Lonkero Browser-Assist extension installed in Chrome

      --auth-type <AUTH_TYPE>
          Authorization type for Browser-Assist mode

          Possible values:
          - bug-bounty:      Bug bounty program authorization
          - pentest:         Pentest engagement
          - internal-audit:  Internal security audit
          - dev-testing:     Dev/staging testing
          - self-authorized: Self-authorized (testing own assets)
          
          [default: self-authorized]

      --scope <SCOPE>
          Scope patterns for Browser-Assist mode (e.g., "*.example.com")

      --audit-log <AUDIT_LOG>
          Audit log output path for Browser-Assist mode

      --no-ml
          Disable ML model scoring (model scoring is one-way, no data leaves your machine)

ai.--basic-auth: HTTP Basic auth to pass through (user:pass)
ai.--proxy: Proxy URL to pass through to lonkero scans
ai.--header: Custom headers to pass through (format: "Header: Value")
ai.--license-key: License key (or set LONKERO_LICENSE_KEY environment variable) [env: LONKERO_LICENSE_KEY=]
